source.note: The 4 daemon binaries were built from the dev tree at the recorded commit + the 3 dirty files (the render-ladder demote-wash hardening). The JS runtime files are copied verbatim from the dev shell/ tree except the bundle.js dist patch below.

unsupported.windows: the Go daemon uses syscall.Flock / LOCK_EX / LOCK_UN (Unix-only file locking, compact_ledger.go); a Windows build requires porting the locking layer

dist_only_modifications: bundle.js: the schemastery config-schema import fallback no longer hardcodes the build machine's nvm absolute path; it probes the running node's global install prefix (process.execPath -> <prefix>/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai[/dsh]/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/schemastery/lib/index.mjs). Any miss keeps the documented z=undefined fallback (config validation skipped, apply() ad-hoc defaults). Verified: the probe resolves schemastery under a plain-node run on the build machine.

cordis.patch.yml: the shipped mount row restates the dev tree's owner-deployment config overrides (e.g. renderLadder: true, the personal pool tuning) as an EMPTY config ({}) — a fresh install starts from the bundle's schemastery schema defaults; the owner's personal row stays in the private dev tree only.
